scripts.dev: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -s first -n web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm -w shared run build && npm -w api run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.build:openapi:api-types: npm run build:openapi && npm run build:api-types
scripts.build:openapi:api-types:stage: npm -w api run build:openapi:stage && npm -w web run build:api-types:stage
scripts.type:check: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -s first -n shared,api,web "npm -w shared run type:check" "npm -w api run type:check" "npm -w web run type:check"
scripts.source:check: npm run biome:check && npm run type:check

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run build:openapi:api-types:stage && npm run source:fix && npm run source:check && npm run test:ci && npm run test:e2e
